description: This 3D donut chart illustrates the composition of a dataset categorized into six distinct data types. A legend positioned to the right of the chart identifies each category by color. The segments include "Moroccan Names" represented by a very small orange slice, "Semantic Categories (e.g., Food, Economy)" shown as a very small purple slice, and "Syntactic Roles (e.g., Verbs, Nouns, Adjectives)" depicted by a medium-sized brown slice that contains a blank, greyed-out rectangular box instead of text. The three largest categories feature white numerical labels within their respective slices: "Translated Sentences" in yellow is labeled with the value 45,387, "Extra + Augmented Data" in blue-grey is labeled with 30,000, and "Pending Translations" in light green is labeled with 43,000. The chart displays absolute numerical values rather than percentages for these three sections, while the remaining three sections lack numerical labels. The segments are not arranged in a strict size-based order around the ring. Visually, the chart employs a three-dimensional effect with a hollow center, and all slices remain connected without any being exploded or offset from the main body.
